methodology: One fixed main SSE observer and two independent extra-market SSE views (CAR–GB and BAL–BUF) on the same cloud instance. All odds collection stays in the cloud. The observer Mac receives public streams and reads metrics only.
limitations: Receive gaps describe delivery of SSE frames, including freshness and heartbeat messages; they are not bookmaker price-change latency.
A quiet period with no observed price changes cannot establish actual odds-change latency.
Decoded UTF-8 SSE frame bytes exclude HTTP/TLS overhead and are not a wire-compression measurement.
Source ages in metric samples use the server-generated time; extra-stream age checks use observer time and may include clock skew.
This is an observation with extras enabled, not a controlled before/after performance benchmark.

analysisNotes: Request-time summaries exclude two pre-window confirmations carried forward in the first measured snapshots (BAL DraftKings and CAR FanDuel). Raw event records and all measured window counters are preserved.
